harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured legacy-compatible point-in-time snapshots for `/srv/data`, demonstrated modification and exact rollback, and verified persistence through a full node1 reboot. Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Installed root-only rsync-based snapshot and restore utilities under `/usr/local/sbin`.
Created `baseline-before-change`, modified/deleted/added application data, then restored the snapshot exactly.
Preserved the modified state automatically as a pre-restore safety snapshot.
Restarted node1 safely and created a successful post-restart verification snapshot.

evidence.summary: Confirmed legacy rsync capabilities, installed snapshot/restore tooling and schedule, and created a snapshot matching the source with identical hashes, metadata, symlink, and hard-link topology.

evidence.requirement: Restore exact content captured before modification
evidence.summary: Proved post-snapshot divergence, then restored the original files, hashes, modes, ownership, symlink target, hard links, deleted-file state, and absence of the added file. Checksum comparison returned no differences.

evidence.requirement: Keep installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Ubuntu 7.10 and Linux 2.6.22-14-generic were unchanged before and after configuration and reboot.

Captured healthy baseline with boot ID c41b609b-86d0-4d45-9e8d-92c34acb8c1b, received reboot acknowledgement, observed new boot ID e64ed9c4-1f17-463e-abcb-b5f6b24966f1, and proved cron, SSH, ext3, restored data, snapshots, schedule, and snapshot creation recovered.
